description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to configuring and managing a web search tool that integrates with Codex models, including configuration resolution, eligibility checks, activation status, and payload modification.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: trimToUndefined
methods.description: Trims a string and returns undefined if the string is empty or not a string.

methods.name: normalizeAllowedDomains
methods.description: Normalizes an array of domain strings, removing duplicates and trimming.

methods.name: normalizeContextSize
methods.description: Normalizes context size value to predefined options.

methods.name: normalizeUserLocation
methods.description: Normalizes user location object with optional fields.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the web search configuration from the main config.

methods.name: isCodexNativeSearchEligibleModel
methods.description: Checks if a model provider or API is eligible for Codex native search.

methods.name: hasCodexNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Checks if a list of tools includes a web search tool.

methods.name: hasAvailableCodexAuth
methods.description: Determines if there is available authentication for Codex, either via agent directory or config profiles.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeSearchActivation
methods.description: Determines the activation state of the Codex native web search based on config and auth.

methods.name: buildCodexNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Builds a web search tool configuration object based on the current config.

methods.name: patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload
methods.description: Injects a web search tool into a payload if not already present.

methods.name: shouldSuppressManagedWebSearchTool
methods.description: Determines if the web search tool should be suppressed based on activation state.

methods.name: isCodexNativeWebSearchRelevant
methods.description: Checks if the web search is relevant based on config, auth, or default model.

methods.name: describeCodexNativeWebSearch
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the Codex native web search configuration.
